examples.en: A cowboy rides a horse and herds cattle.
Cowboys appear in Western movies.

examples.ko: 아이가 카우보이 모자를 쓰고 사진을 찍었어요.
examples.en: The child wore a cowboy hat and took a photo.
I watched a movie with a cowboy as the hero.
My uncle wears boots like a cowboy.
Even a cowboy gets tired after working all day.

explain: 영어 cowboy에서 온 외래어로, 미국 서부에서 말을 타고 소를 키우는 사람을 떠올리게 해요. '카우보이 모자', '카우보이 부츠'처럼 뒤에 다른 말을 붙여 쓰기도 해요.

phrases.example: 아버지가 카우보이 모자를 쓰고 사진을 찍었어요.
phrases.en: My father took a photo wearing a cowboy hat.
phrases.nuance_ko: '카우보이' 뒤에 물건 이름을 붙이면 그 사람이 쓰는 물건을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding an item name makes it that thing a cowboy wears.

phrases.example: 카우보이 부츠를 신으니까 키가 커 보여요.
phrases.en: I look taller wearing cowboy boots.
phrases.nuance_ko: 모자처럼 옷차림을 이야기할 때 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Another common pairing when talking about clothes.

phrases.en: I watched a cowboy movie on the weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: 서부 이야기를 다룬 영화를 가리킬 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to a movie about the American West.

explain_en: A loanword from English 'cowboy', it calls to mind people on horseback raising cattle in the American West. It is often followed by another word: '카우보이 모자' (cowboy hat), '카우보이 부츠' (cowboy boots).

examples.en: The eldest son's wife has a lot to do during the holidays.
The eldest son's wife in our family is a good cook.
Grandmother trusts her eldest daughter-in-law the most.
She married in as the eldest son's wife and held the ancestral rites.
The whole family gathered for the eldest daughter-in-law's birthday.
The eldest and younger daughters-in-law get along well.

explain: 큰아들의 아내를 말하고, 짝말은 '작은며느리'(또는 '둘째 며느리')예요. 전통적으로 제사와 명절 일을 많이 맡는 자리라는 느낌이 있어요.

phrases.en: The eldest son's wife is busy during holidays.
phrases.nuance_ko: '큰며느리'와 거의 같은 뜻이고 조금 더 전통적인 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Almost the same as 'keun-myeoneuri', a little more traditional.

phrases.example: 그분은 작년에 이 집의 큰며느리가 되었어요.
phrases.en: She became this family's eldest daughter-in-law last year.
phrases.nuance_ko: 큰아들과 결혼해서 그 자리가 될 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when marrying the first son and taking that role.

phrases.en: We welcomed our eldest daughter-in-law last year.
phrases.nuance_ko: 시부모 입장에서 며느리를 맞이했다고 할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Said from the in-laws' side when gaining a daughter-in-law.

explain_en: It means the eldest son's wife, and the counterpart is '작은며느리' (or '둘째 며느리' for the second). Traditionally it carries a sense of the person who takes on much of the ancestral rites and holiday work.

examples.en: My eldest brother is ten years older than me.

examples.ko: 큰형이 회사에 다닌 지 오 년이 됐어요.
examples.en: It has been five years since my eldest brother started working at a company.
When I was little, I learned Hangeul from my eldest brother.
On holidays the family gathers at my eldest brother's house.
I take after my eldest brother, so I am tall.
My eldest brother and I have similar hobbies.

explain: 남자가 자기 형을 부르는 말이 '형'이고, 여자는 '오빠'라고 해요. 형이 둘 이상이면 가장 위를 '큰형', 그다음은 '둘째 형'이라고 해요. 직접 부를 때는 보통 그냥 '형'이라고 불러요.

phrases.en: My eldest brother always helps me.
phrases.nuance_ko: '님'을 붙여서 더 높이는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding '님' makes it more respectful.

phrases.en: I called my eldest brother on the weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: '한테'는 말할 때 '에게' 대신 많이 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: '한테' is used in speech instead of '에게'.

phrases.en: My eldest brother is good at cooking.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가족을 말할 때는 '내' 대신 '우리'를 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: For family, Koreans often say '우리' instead of 'my'.

explain_en: A man calls his older brother '형', while a woman says '오빠'. With two or more older brothers, the eldest is 큰형 and the next is '둘째 형'. When calling him directly, people usually just say '형'.

examples.en: This video was made for children's education.
My child learns Hangul with an educational app.
This game is educational, not for entertainment.
This book is for teaching, so the pictures are easy.
There are ones for education and ones for play.
It's material too good to be used only for teaching.

explain: '-용'은 쓰임새를 나타내서 '가정용, 업무용, 연습용, 어린이용'처럼 써요. '교육용 자료', '교육용 프로그램'처럼 뒤의 명사를 꾸미는 말로 많이 나와요. 반대로 즐기려는 것은 '오락용'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: The teacher sent us educational materials.
phrases.nuance_ko: 공부를 위해 만든 자료를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Materials made for studying.

phrases.en: The children watch an educational program.
phrases.nuance_ko: 배움을 목적으로 한 방송이나 앱을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A show or app made for learning.

phrases.en: You may use this video for education.
phrases.nuance_ko: '-용으로'는 어떤 목적으로 쓰는지 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: -용으로 states the purpose for which something is used.

explain_en: The suffix '-용' shows purpose, as in '가정용, 업무용, 연습용, 어린이용'. It often modifies a following noun, as in '교육용 자료' or '교육용 프로그램'. For things meant for fun, you say '오락용'.

examples.en: I learned that the antonym of 'big' is 'small'.

examples.ko: 반의어를 같이 외우면 단어가 더 잘 기억나요.
examples.en: If you memorize antonyms together, you remember words better.
By any chance, what is the antonym of this word?
'Hot' and 'cold' are antonyms of each other.
There are quite a lot of words that don't even have antonyms.
A question about choosing the antonym came up in the exam.

explain: 일상 대화에서는 '반대말'이라고 많이 하고, 수업이나 시험에서는 '반의어'가 자주 나와요. 비슷한 뜻의 말은 '유의어'나 '비슷한말'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: The opposite of 'hot' is 'cold'.
phrases.nuance_ko: 일상 대화에서는 '반의어' 대신 '반대말'을 많이 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: In daily talk, people say '반대말' more than '반의어'.

phrases.en: I study antonyms and synonyms together.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뜻이 반대인 말과 비슷한 말을 함께 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to mention opposite and similar words together.

phrases.en: I looked up the antonym in the dictionary.
phrases.nuance_ko: 공부하면서 반대되는 단어를 알아볼 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when looking for an opposite word while studying.

explain_en: In everyday talk people often say '반대말', while '반의어' appears more in class and exams. Words with similar meanings are '유의어' or '비슷한말'.

examples.en: My mother finished girls' middle school and went on to high school.
There is one girls' middle school in my neighborhood.
There are many stationery shops in front of the girls' middle school.
My older sister was in the basketball club at girls' middle school.

examples.ko: 그 여중은 학생 수가 많지 않아요.
examples.en: That girls' middle school does not have many students.

examples.ko: 여중과 남중이 한 건물을 같이 써요.
examples.en: The girls' and boys' middle schools share one building.

explain: '여자 중학교'를 줄인 말이에요. 짝이 되는 말은 '남중'이고, 고등학교는 '여고', '남고'예요. 남녀가 같이 다니는 학교는 '남녀공학'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: My younger sister is a girls' middle school student.
phrases.nuance_ko: 여중에 다니는 학생을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A student who attends a girls' middle school.

phrases.en: I go to a girls' middle school near my house.
phrases.nuance_ko: 지금 그 학교의 학생일 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when you are currently a student there.
phrases.en_equiv: to attend a girls' middle school

phrases.en: The girls' middle school is close to my home.
phrases.nuance_ko: '여중'을 줄이지 않은 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The full form of '여중'.

explain_en: It is a shortened form of 여자 중학교. The boys' version is 남중, and high schools are 여고 and 남고. A school for both is called 남녀공학.

examples.en: The teacher shouted 'Attention!' in a loud voice.

examples.ko: 교장 선생님이 오시자 반장이 '차렷!' 하고 말했어요.
examples.en: When the principal came, the class president said 'Attention!'

examples.ko: 모두 차렷 자세로 똑바로 서 있어요.
examples.en: Everyone is standing straight in the attention posture.

examples.ko: 차렷 하면 팔을 몸 옆에 붙이세요.
examples.en: When I say 'attention', keep your arms at your sides.

examples.ko: 아이들이 차렷 하고 서서 국기에 인사해요.
examples.en: The children stand at attention and salute the flag.

examples.ko: 군인처럼 차렷 하고 섰더니 친구들이 웃었어요.
examples.en: My friends laughed when I stood at attention like a soldier.

explain: 학교나 군대에서 쓰는 구령이에요. 보통 '차렷, 경례' 순서로 이어지고, 편하게 서라고 할 때는 '쉬어'라고 해요.

phrases.en: We stood at attention on the playground.
phrases.nuance_ko: 구령이 아니라 똑바로 선 자세를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to the standing posture, not the command.

phrases.en: The class president said, 'Attention, salute!'
phrases.nuance_ko: '차렷' 다음에 '경례'가 이어지는 순서로 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: '경례' follows '차렷' in this fixed order.

phrases.example: 선생님이 오시자 모두 차렷 하고 섰어요.
phrases.en: When the teacher came, everyone stood at attention.
phrases.nuance_ko: 구령에 맞춰 똑바로 서는 모습을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes standing straight at the command.

explain_en: Command to stand straight and still (똑바로) It is a command used at school and in the military. It usually comes in the order '차렷, 경례' (attention, salute), and '쉬어' means stand at ease.

t90.ax: The teacher shouted 'Attention!' in a loud voice.

examples.en: On my trip to Japan I went to a karaoke place.
Karaoke is a machine for singing along to accompaniment.
I put a karaoke machine in the living room.
My friend likes karaoke, so we go often.
I liked the song I sang at karaoke.

examples.ko: 우리 동네에는 가라오케도 있고 노래방도 있어요.
examples.en: My neighborhood has both a karaoke bar and a noraebang.

explain: 한국에서 노래를 부르는 곳은 보통 '노래방'이라고 해요. '가라오케'는 일본에서 온 말이라 일본이나 외국의 시설을 이야기할 때 쓰는 경우가 많아요.

phrases.en: In Korea, I often go to a noraebang with friends.
phrases.nuance_ko: 한국에서 노래하는 곳은 보통 '노래방'이라고 해요.
phrases.nuance_en: In Korea, the usual word for the place is 노래방.

phrases.en: I sang a Korean song at a karaoke place.
phrases.nuance_ko: 외국의 시설을 이야기할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when talking about places abroad.

phrases.en: I sang along to the karaoke backing music.
phrases.nuance_ko: 노래 소리 없이 나오는 음악 부분을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to the music played without the vocals.

explain_en: In Korea the usual word for a place to sing is '노래방'. '가라오케' came from Japan and is often used when talking about facilities in Japan or abroad.

t90.ax: I liked the song I sang at karaoke.

examples.en: I saw a gorilla at the zoo.
The gorilla beat its chest.
Gorillas eat leaves.
The child walked like a gorilla.
I received a gorilla doll as a gift.
Gorillas also live together in family groups.

explain: '침팬지'와 같은 무리의 동물이에요. 몸은 침팬지보다 훨씬 크고, 꼬리가 없다는 점은 같아요.

phrases.example: 아기 고릴라가 엄마 등에 앉아 있어요.
phrases.en: The baby gorilla is sitting on its mother's back.
phrases.nuance_ko: 새끼 동물은 '아기'를 앞에 붙여 말할 수 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: You can put '아기' before an animal name to mean its baby.

phrases.en: That person is strong like a gorilla.
phrases.nuance_ko: '-처럼'을 붙여 힘이 센 모습 등을 비유할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: With '-처럼' it works as a comparison, often for strength.

phrases.en: Chimpanzees and gorillas look alike.
phrases.nuance_ko: 비슷한 동물과 같이 말할 때 '-와'로 이어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Link it with a similar animal using '-와'.

explain_en: It belongs to the same group of animals as the 침팬지. A gorilla is much bigger than a chimpanzee, and both have no tail.

examples.ko: 두 번째 넘버를 부를 때 박수가 나왔어요.
examples.en: There was applause when they sang the second number.
A big number is written on the uniform.
I want to be number one.

examples.ko: 이 곡은 제가 제일 좋아하는 넘버예요.
examples.en: This is my favorite number.
We found the owner by the car number.
Musical numbers are easy to memorize.

explain: 일반적으로 숫자를 말할 때는 '번호'를 써요. '넘버'는 '넘버 원', '뮤지컬 넘버'처럼 외래어 표현 안에서 써요.

phrases.en: That singer is number one in our country.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가장 뛰어난 사람이나 물건을 말하는 외래어 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A loanword expression for the best person or thing.

phrases.en: I like this musical number the best.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뮤지컬에서 한 곡을 부르는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to one song in a musical.

phrases.en: Please tell me your phone number.
phrases.nuance_ko: 일반적으로 숫자를 말할 때는 '넘버'보다 '번호'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: For ordinary numbers, 번호 is used rather than 넘버.

explain_en: English loanword; casual, trendy, sports numbers or song numbers. For a plain number, use 'beonho'. 'Neombeo' appears inside loanword expressions like 'number one' and 'musical number'.

gh: count or quantity as an abstract number

p.n: 넘버 sounds trendy or casual; 숫자 is the neutral Korean word.

examples.en: I received a ruby ring as a gift.
A ruby is a red gem.
A ruby is set in my grandmother's necklace.
The sunset was red like a ruby.
It sparkles more when I wipe the ruby with a cloth.
Which do you like, ruby or diamond?

explain: 탄생석 이야기를 할 때 '7월은 루비'처럼 말해요. 붉은 보석이라서 '루비색'이라고 하면 진한 붉은색을 가리켜요.

phrases.en: This lipstick is a deep ruby color.
phrases.nuance_ko: 보석 이름을 색 이름으로 쓴 말로 진한 붉은색을 가리켜요.
phrases.nuance_en: Uses the gem's name as a color name for deep red.

phrases.en: I gave my mother a ruby necklace.
phrases.nuance_ko: 루비로 만든 장신구를 말할 때 '루비' 뒤에 물건 이름을 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put the item name after 루비 to talk about ruby jewelry.

phrases.en: The red ruby sparkles.
phrases.nuance_ko: 루비의 색깔을 꾸며 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to describe the color of a ruby.

explain_en: In talk about birthstones, people say 'July is ruby'. Because it is a red gem, 'rubisaek' points to a deep red color.

examples.en: I learned how to greet people in Mongolian from a Mongolian friend.
They say Mongolian has a word order similar to Korean.
I'm majoring in Mongolian at university.

examples.ko: 몽골어 수업이 일주일에 두 번 있어요.
examples.en: There are Mongolian classes twice a week.
I'd like to try studying Mongolian later too.
A Mongolian interpreter attended the meeting.

explain: '몽골'에 '-어'를 붙여 언어 이름을 만들어요. 일본어, 영어, 러시아어처럼 나라 이름에 '-어'가 붙는 말이 많아요. '몽골어를 배우다', '몽골어로 말하다'처럼 '을/를'과 '(으)로'를 구별해서 써요.

phrases.en: I introduced myself in Mongolian.
phrases.nuance_ko: 어떤 언어로 말하는지 '(으)로'로 나타내요.
phrases.nuance_en: '(으)로' shows which language you speak in.

phrases.en: I'm going to learn Mongolian next year.
phrases.nuance_ko: 배우는 언어는 '을/를'과 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The language being learned takes '을/를'.

phrases.en: The Mongolian class is fun.
phrases.nuance_ko: 언어 이름 뒤에 '수업'을 붙여 쓸 수 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: You can add '수업' after a language name.

explain_en: Adding '-어' to '몽골' gives the name of the language, like 일본어, 영어 and 러시아어. Use '을/를' for the object and '(으)로' for the language used, as in '몽골어를 배우다' and '몽골어로 말하다'.

examples.en: Yesterday's soccer match ended in a tie.
The two teams ended up in a tie.
It's a pity that this match was a tie.

examples.ko: 우리 팀은 이번 시즌에 무승부를 두 번 기록했어요.
examples.en: Our team drew twice this season.
Because the game was a tie, everyone applauded.
In a tie, each team gets one point.

explain: 경기가 같은 점수로 끝났을 때 쓰는 명사라서 '무승부가 되다', '무승부로 끝나다'처럼 써요. 같은 상황의 동사는 '비기다'예요. '승리', '패배'와 나란히 알아 두세요.

phrases.example: 두 팀이 이 대 이로 비겼어요.
phrases.en: The two teams tied two to two.
phrases.nuance_ko: '무승부'와 같은 상황을 동사로 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The verb for the same situation as 무승부.

phrases.en: There were many drawn games, so it wasn't fun.
phrases.nuance_ko: 점수가 같게 끝난 경기를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A game that ended with equal scores.

phrases.en: It was a tie, so I feel disappointed.
phrases.nuance_ko: '이다'의 이유 형태로 결과를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Gives the tie as a reason.

explain_en: Final result of a game or match with no winner (무승부로 끝나다) It is a noun for a game that ends with equal scores, used as '무승부가 되다' or '무승부로 끝나다'. The verb for the same situation is '비기다'. Learn it together with '승리' (win) and '패배' (loss).

t90.ax: The two teams ended up in a tie.
